note.zh: 始建國三年（11）河決後，東流入海約六十年無人治理，永平十二至十三年（69–70）修治，此後穩定近千年，至慶曆八年（1048）商胡決口。
note.en: After the breach of 11 CE the river ran east unmanaged for some sixty years; it was brought under control in 69–70 and then held for nearly a thousand years, until the Shanghu breach of 1048.

passages.locator: 卷九十九中 王莽傳 始建國三年
passages.textZh: 河決魏郡，泛清河以東數郡。
passages.textEn: The river broke its banks in Wei commandery and flooded several commanderies east of Qinghe.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二 顯宗孝明帝紀 永平十二年
passages.textZh: 夏四月，遣將作謁者王吳修汴渠，自滎陽至于千乘海口。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month the Internuncio of Works Wang Wu was sent to repair the Bian canal, from Xingyang to the sea at Qiancheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二 顯宗孝明帝紀 永平十三年
passages.textZh: 夏四月，汴渠成。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month the Bian canal was finished.

passages.locator: 卷十一 仁宗紀 慶曆八年
passages.textZh: 丙子，河決澶州商胡埽。
passages.textEn: On bingzi the river broke through at the Shanghu dike in Chanzhou.

note.zh: 五代後晉開運元年（944）河決，水環梁山，此後以梁山泊之名見於記載；大野澤與梁山泊的承接關係為今人推定。
note.en: After the breach of 944 the water surrounded Mount Liang and is recorded from then on as Liangshan Marsh; that it continued the Daye Marsh is a modern inference.

properties.zh: 渤海西岸·今黃河三角洲
properties.en: Bohai shore & modern Yellow River delta

passages.locator: 卷四下 世祖紀下 太平真君七年
passages.textZh: 丙戌，發司、幽、定、冀四州十萬人築畿上塞圍，起上谷，西至于河，廣袤皆千里。
passages.textEn: On bingxu a hundred thousand men of Si, You, Ding and Ji were raised to build the barrier around the capital region, from Shanggu west to the Yellow River, a thousand li each way.

properties.zh: 北齊長城（黃櫨嶺—社干戍）

passages.locator: 卷四 文宣帝紀 天保三年
passages.textZh: 冬十月乙未，至黃櫨嶺，仍起長城，北至社干戍四百餘里，立三十六戍。
passages.textEn: On yiwei of the tenth month he reached Huanglu ridge and began a long wall running north to the Shegan post, over four hundred li, with thirty-six garrisons.

passages.locator: 卷四 文宣帝紀 天保六年
passages.textZh: 是年，發夫一百八十萬人築長城，自幽州北夏口至恒州九百餘里。
passages.textEn: That year 1,800,000 labourers were raised to build a long wall from Xiakou north of Youzhou to Hengzhou, over nine hundred li.

note.zh: 梁為水灌北魏壽陽而築，橫截淮水；天監十五年（516）秋潰決。
note.en: Built by Liang across the Huai to flood the Northern Wei at Shouyang; it burst in the autumn of 516.

passages.locator: 卷二 武帝紀中 天監十三年
passages.textZh: 是歲作浮山堰。
passages.textEn: That year the Fushan dam was built.

passages.locator: 卷十八 康絢傳
passages.textZh: 至其秋八月，淮水暴長，堰悉壞決，奔流于海
passages.textEn: In the eighth month that autumn the Huai rose suddenly and the whole dam broke, pouring away to the sea.

properties.en: Man peoples of the Huai and Han hills

note.zh: 自周定王五年（前602）河徙至王莽始建國三年（11）河決魏郡。路線為今人復原。
note.en: From the move of 602 BCE to the breach in Wei commandery in 11 CE. The course is a modern reconstruction.

passages.locator: 卷二十九 溝洫志（王橫語）
passages.textZh: 禹之行河水，本隨西山下東北去。周譜云定王五年河徙，則今所行非禹之所穿也。
passages.textEn: Yu led the river north-east along the foot of the western mountains. The Zhou genealogies say the river moved in the fifth year of King Ding, so the course it follows now is not the one Yu cut.

passages.locator: 卷九十九中 王莽傳 始建國三年
passages.textZh: 河決魏郡，泛清河以東數郡。
passages.textEn: The river broke its banks in Wei commandery and flooded several commanderies east of Qinghe.

note.zh: 北宋時北流、東流屢有反覆：1048年商胡決口成北流；1069年閉北流，河歸東流；1081年小吳埽決，復歸北流；1094年再閉北流；1099年內黃決口，東流斷絕，復歸北流，至1128年南流。
note.en: Under Northern Song the river switched back and forth: north after the Shanghu breach of 1048; east when the northern course was closed in 1069; north again after the Xiaowu breach of 1081; east in 1094; north for good after the Neihuang breach of 1099, until it turned south in 1128.

passages.locator: 卷十一 仁宗紀 慶曆八年
passages.textZh: 丙子，河決澶州商胡埽。
passages.textEn: On bingzi the river broke through at the Shanghu dike in Chanzhou.

passages.locator: 卷九十一 河渠志一 熙寧二年
passages.textZh: 丙午，大河東徙，北流淺小。戊申，北流閉。
passages.textEn: On bingwu the river shifted east and the northern course became shallow; on wushen the northern course was closed.

passages.locator: 卷二十五 高宗紀 建炎二年
passages.textZh: 是冬，杜充決黃河，自泗入淮，以阻金兵。
passages.textEn: That winter Du Chong breached the Yellow River, sending it through the Si into the Huai, to stop the Jin army.

note.zh: 《史記》不記開鑿之年；約前360年魏惠王時之說出自後世引《竹書紀年》，此處未核。廢棄年代亦不詳。
note.en: The Shiji gives no date; the c. 360 BCE date under King Hui of Wei comes from later quotations of the Bamboo Annals, not checked here. When it fell out of use is also unknown.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 滎陽下引河東南為鴻溝，以通宋、鄭、陳、蔡、曹、衛，與濟、汝、淮、泗會。
passages.textEn: Below Xingyang the river was led south-east as the Hong canal, connecting Song, Zheng, Chen, Cai, Cao and Wei and joining the Ji, Ru, Huai and Si.

note.zh: 《淮南子》不記年份；秦攻百越約在始皇二十八至三十三年（前219–前214）。
note.en: The Huainanzi gives no year; Qin's war on the Yue ran from about 219 to 214 BCE.

passages.locator: 人間訓
passages.textZh: 使監祿無以轉餉，又以卒鑿渠而通糧道，以與越人戰
passages.textEn: The overseer Lu, having no way to move supplies, had soldiers cut a canal to open a supply route, and fought the Yue.

note.zh: 開鑿之年《史記》未明言，一般繫於秦王政元年（前246）。
note.en: The Shiji does not give the year; it is usually placed in 246 BCE.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 乃使水工鄭國閒說秦，令鑿涇水自中山西邸瓠口為渠，并北山東注洛三百餘里，欲以溉田。
passages.textEn: Han sent the water engineer Zheng Guo to Qin as a spy, to persuade it to cut a canal from the Jing river west of Zhongshan at Hukou, running east along the northern hills to the Luo, over three hundred li, to irrigate fields.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Sui (Wei Zheng et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷三 煬帝紀上 大業元年
passages.textZh: 辛亥，發河南諸郡男女百餘萬，開通濟渠，自西苑引穀、洛水達于河，自板渚引河通于淮。
passages.textEn: On xinhai more than a million men and women of the Henan commanderies were raised to dig the Tongji canal, leading the Gu and Luo from the Western Park to the Yellow River, and from Banzhu leading the Yellow River to the Huai.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Sui (Wei Zheng et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷三 煬帝紀上 大業四年
passages.textZh: 四年春正月乙巳，詔發河北諸郡男女百餘萬開永濟渠，引沁水南達于河，北通涿郡。
passages.textEn: On yisi of the first month of the fourth year more than a million men and women of the Hebei commanderies were raised to dig the Yongji canal, leading the Qin river south to the Yellow River and north to Zhuo commandery.

passages.sourceEn: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance (Sima Guang, 1084)
passages.locator: 卷一百八十一 大業六年
passages.textZh: 敕穿江南河，自京口至餘杭，八百餘里，廣十餘丈，使可通龍舟
passages.textEn: An edict ordered the Jiangnan canal dug from Jingkou to Yuhang, over eight hundred li and more than ten zhang wide, so that the dragon boats could pass.

properties.en: Northern walls of Qin, Zhao and Yan

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 於是秦有隴西、北地、上郡，築長城以拒胡。而趙武靈王亦變俗胡服，習騎射，北破林胡、樓煩。築長城，自代并陰山下，至高闕爲塞。
passages.textEn: So Qin held Longxi, Beidi and Shang and built a long wall against the nomads. King Wuling of Zhao too adopted nomad dress and mounted archery, broke the Linhu and Loufan, and built a long wall from Dai along the foot of the Yin mountains to Gaoque.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百十 匈奴列傳
passages.textZh: 燕亦築長城，自造陽至襄平。
passages.textEn: Yan too built a long wall, from Zaoyang to Xiangping.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷八十八 蒙恬列傳
passages.textZh: 乃使蒙恬將三十萬眾北逐戎狄，收河南。筑長城，因地形，用制險塞，起臨洮，至遼東，延袤萬餘里。
passages.textEn: He sent Meng Tian with three hundred thousand men north to drive out the Rong and Di and take the land south of the river. He built a long wall, following the lie of the land and using its defiles, from Lintao to Liaodong, over ten thousand li.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷一百二十三 大宛列傳
passages.textZh: 於是酒泉列亭鄣至玉門矣。
passages.textEn: Then Jiuquan lined its forts and watchtowers as far as Yumen.

note.zh: 王橫說禹河「本隨西山下東北去」，至周定王五年（前602）河徙。路線按《禹貢》「北過降水，至于大陸」由今人推定，誤差甚大。
note.en: Wang Heng said Yu's river ran "north-east along the foot of the western mountains" until it moved in 602 BCE. The course follows the Yu Gong ("north past the Jiang, to the Dalu marsh") as reconstructed today, and is very uncertain.

passages.locator: 卷二十九 溝洫志（王橫語）
passages.textZh: 禹之行河水，本隨西山下東北去。周譜云定王五年河徙，則今所行非禹之所穿也。
passages.textEn: Yu led the river north-east along the foot of the western mountains. The Zhou genealogies say the river moved in the fifth year of King Ding, so the course it follows now is not the one Yu cut.

note.zh: 元光三年（前132）決口，元封二年（前109）堵塞。泛道為今人推定。
note.en: Broke in 132 BCE, closed in 109 BCE. The floodway is a modern reconstruction.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 今天子元光之中，而河決於瓠子，東南注鉅野，通於淮、泗。
passages.textEn: In the Yuanguang years of the present emperor the river broke through at Huzi and poured south-east into the Juye marsh and on to the Huai and Si.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 自河決瓠子後二十餘歲，歲因以數不登，而梁楚之地尤甚。
passages.textEn: For more than twenty years after the Huzi breach harvests failed again and again, worst of all in Liang and Chu.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 天子乃使汲仁、郭昌發卒數萬人塞瓠子決。
passages.textEn: The emperor sent Ji Ren and Guo Chang with tens of thousands of men to close the Huzi breach.

note.zh: 隋開皇七年（587）重開為山陽瀆。路線為約略。
note.en: Re-dug in 587 as the Shanyang channel. The route is approximate.

passages.locator: 哀公九年
passages.textZh: 秋．吳城邗．溝通江淮．
passages.textEn: In autumn Wu walled Han and cut a canal joining the Yangzi and the Huai.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Sui (Wei Zheng et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 高祖紀上 開皇七年
passages.textZh: 庚戌，於揚州開山陽瀆，以通運漕。
passages.textEn: On gengxu the Shanyang channel was dug at Yangzhou for grain transport.

note.zh: 東漢修成，自滎陽東經浚儀至彭城入泗；隋大業元年（605）通濟渠開，此後以通濟渠為主幹。路線為約略。
note.en: Completed under Eastern Han, from Xingyang east past Junyi to the Si at Pengcheng; from 605 the Tongji canal became the main line. The route is approximate.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二 顯宗孝明帝紀 永平十二年
passages.textZh: 夏四月，遣將作謁者王吳修汴渠，自滎陽至于千乘海口。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month the Internuncio of Works Wang Wu was sent to repair the Bian canal, from Xingyang to the sea at Qiancheng.

passages.sourceEn: Book of the Later Han (Fan Ye, 445)
passages.locator: 卷二 顯宗孝明帝紀 永平十三年
passages.textZh: 夏四月，汴渠成。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month the Bian canal was finished.

note.zh: 元光六年（前129）鄭當時建議開鑿，三年而通；廢棄年代不詳，以漢亡為止。
note.en: Proposed by Zheng Dangshi in 129 BCE and open three years later; when it fell out of use is unknown, so it is drawn until the end of Han.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Grand Historian (Sima Qian, c. 91 BCE)
passages.locator: 卷二十九 河渠書
passages.textZh: 引渭穿渠起長安，并南山下，至河三百餘里，徑，易漕，度可令三月罷
passages.textEn: Lead the Wei through a canal from Chang'an along the southern hills to the Yellow River, three hundred li: shorter and easier for grain boats, three months instead of six.

note.zh: 隋大業四年（608）併入永濟渠。路線為約略。
note.en: Taken into the Yongji canal in 608. The route is approximate.

passages.sourceEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms (Chen Shou, c. 290)
passages.locator: 魏書一 武帝紀 建安九年
passages.textZh: 遏淇水入白溝以通糧道。
passages.textEn: He dammed the Qi river and turned it into the Bai channel to open a supply route.

note.zh: 大致循漢漕渠故道。路線為約略。
note.en: Roughly along the old Han transport canal. The route is approximate.

passages.sourceEn: Book of Sui (Wei Zheng et al., 636)
passages.locator: 卷一 高祖紀上 開皇四年
passages.textZh: 壬子，開渠，自渭達河以通運漕。
passages.textEn: On renzi a canal was dug from the Wei to the Yellow River for grain transport.

note.zh: 路線為約略；以北魏分裂（534）為止。
note.en: The line is approximate; drawn until Northern Wei split in 534.

passages.locator: 卷三 太宗紀 泰常八年
passages.textZh: 二月戊辰，築長城於長川之南，起自赤城，西至五原，延袤二千餘里，備置戍衞。
passages.textEn: On wuchen of the second month a long wall was built south of Changchuan, from Chicheng west to Wuyuan, over two thousand li, with garrisons along it.

note.zh: 範圍為約略。
note.en: The extent is approximate.

passages.sourceEn: Old History of the Five Dynasties (Xue Juzheng et al., 974)
passages.locator: 卷八十二 少帝紀 開運元年
passages.textZh: 丙辰，滑州河決，漂註曹、單、濮、鄆等州之境，環梁山合於汶、濟。
passages.textEn: On bingchen the river broke through at Huazhou, flooding Cao, Shan, Pu and Yun, surrounding Mount Liang and joining the Wen and Ji.

passages.locator: 卷九十一 河渠志一 天禧三年
passages.textZh: 天禧三年六月乙未夜，滑州河溢城西北天臺山旁，俄復潰於城西南，岸摧七百步，漫溢州城，曆澶、濮、曹、鄆，注梁山泊
passages.textEn: On the night of yiwei in the sixth month of 1019 the river overflowed by Mount Tiantai north-west of Huazhou, then broke through south-west of the city, tearing away seven hundred paces of bank; it flooded the city and ran through Chan, Pu, Cao and Yun into the Liangshan Marsh.

note.zh: 北宋時北流、東流屢有反覆：1048年商胡決口成北流；1069年閉北流，河歸東流；1081年小吳埽決，復歸北流；1094年再閉北流；1099年內黃決口，東流斷絕，復歸北流，至1128年南流。
note.en: Under Northern Song the river switched back and forth: north after the Shanghu breach of 1048; east when the northern course was closed in 1069; north again after the Xiaowu breach of 1081; east in 1094; north for good after the Neihuang breach of 1099, until it turned south in 1128.

passages.locator: 卷九十二 河渠志二 元豐四年
passages.textZh: 四年四月，小吳埽復大決，自澶注入御河，恩州危甚。
passages.textEn: In the fourth month of the fourth year [1081] the Xiaowu dike broke again, badly, pouring from Chan into the Imperial canal; Enzhou was in great danger.

passages.locator: 卷九十二 河渠志二 元豐四年
passages.textZh: 六月戊午，詔：「東流已填淤不可復，將來更不修閉小吳決口
passages.textEn: On wuwu of the sixth month an edict said: "The eastern course has silted up and cannot be restored; the Xiaowu breach is not to be closed."

passages.locator: 卷九十三 河渠志三 紹聖元年
passages.textZh: 盡閉北流，全河之水，東還故道。
passages.textEn: The northern course was closed altogether, and the whole river returned east to its old bed.

note.zh: 北宋時北流、東流屢有反覆：1048年商胡決口成北流；1069年閉北流，河歸東流；1081年小吳埽決，復歸北流；1094年再閉北流；1099年內黃決口，東流斷絕，復歸北流，至1128年南流。
note.en: Under Northern Song the river switched back and forth: north after the Shanghu breach of 1048; east when the northern course was closed in 1069; north again after the Xiaowu breach of 1081; east in 1094; north for good after the Neihuang breach of 1099, until it turned south in 1128.

passages.locator: 卷九十三 河渠志三 元符二年
passages.textZh: 六月末，河決內黃口，東流遂斷絕。
passages.textEn: At the end of the sixth month the river broke through at Neihuang, and the eastern course was cut off.

passages.locator: 卷二十五 高宗紀 建炎二年
passages.textZh: 是冬，杜充決黃河，自泗入淮，以阻金兵。
passages.textEn: That winter Du Chong breached the Yellow River, sending it through the Si into the Huai, to stop the Jin army.

note.zh: 北宋時北流、東流屢有反覆：1048年商胡決口成北流；1069年閉北流，河歸東流；1081年小吳埽決，復歸北流；1094年再閉北流；1099年內黃決口，東流斷絕，復歸北流，至1128年南流。
note.en: Under Northern Song the river switched back and forth: north after the Shanghu breach of 1048; east when the northern course was closed in 1069; north again after the Xiaowu breach of 1081; east in 1094; north for good after the Neihuang breach of 1099, until it turned south in 1128.

passages.locator: 卷九十一 河渠志一 嘉祐五年
passages.textZh: 五年，河流派別于魏之第六埽，曰二股河，其廣二百尺。
passages.textEn: In the fifth year [1060] the river split off at the sixth dike of Wei into the Ergu channel, two hundred chi wide.

passages.locator: 卷九十一 河渠志一 熙寧二年
passages.textZh: 丙午，大河東徙，北流淺小。戊申，北流閉。
passages.textEn: On bingwu the river shifted east and the northern course became shallow; on wushen the northern course was closed.

passages.locator: 卷九十二 河渠志二 元豐四年
passages.textZh: 六月戊午，詔：「東流已填淤不可復，將來更不修閉小吳決口
passages.textEn: On wuwu of the sixth month an edict said: "The eastern course has silted up and cannot be restored; the Xiaowu breach is not to be closed."

note.zh: 北宋時北流、東流屢有反覆：1048年商胡決口成北流；1069年閉北流，河歸東流；1081年小吳埽決，復歸北流；1094年再閉北流；1099年內黃決口，東流斷絕，復歸北流，至1128年南流。
note.en: Under Northern Song the river switched back and forth: north after the Shanghu breach of 1048; east when the northern course was closed in 1069; north again after the Xiaowu breach of 1081; east in 1094; north for good after the Neihuang breach of 1099, until it turned south in 1128.

passages.locator: 卷九十三 河渠志三 紹聖元年
passages.textZh: 盡閉北流，全河之水，東還故道。
passages.textEn: The northern course was closed altogether, and the whole river returned east to its old bed.

passages.locator: 卷九十三 河渠志三 元符二年
passages.textZh: 六月末，河決內黃口，東流遂斷絕。
passages.textEn: At the end of the sixth month the river broke through at Neihuang, and the eastern course was cut off.
